Executive Summary

Item Result
Feature Under Test Product & Download Page Open Graph Meta Tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card, twitter:image) and 404 Response Handling
Previous Defect Re-Checked Missing / broken Open Graph image previews on social platforms (LinkedIn, Telegram, X.com) and improper 404 response on product endpoints
Fix Re-Validation Verdict Verified & Resolved. Active product pages (/product/virtual-tour-creator, /product/street-view-publishing) and Photo Studio download page (/download/gothru-photo-studio) return full Open Graph tags with valid direct image assets (HTTP 200). Invalid slugs cleanly render 404 Not Found.
Test Coverage White Box (DOM meta tags inspection), Gray Box (Live image asset resolution & Content-Type verification), Black Box (Negative invalid slug 404 validation)
Test Execution Status ✅ 1 Passed (0 Failed)
Final Verdict Passed · Solved

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification (Developer Description Deep-Dive)

    • src/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:
      • Generates dynamic metadata utilizing api.marketing.seo.get and fallback titles/descriptions.
      • Sets full openGraph object including title, description, url, type: 'website', logo, and valid images URLs.
      • Non-existent or inactive products safely invoke Next.js notFound().
    • src/app/download/[slug]/page.tsx:
      • Generates full Open Graph metadata for gothru-photo-studio with preview image asset /assets-next/images/gothru-photo-studio-new/product-banner/image-01-dark.jpg.
    • Live HTTP Inspection:
      • /product/virtual-tour-creator: og:title, og:description, and og:image (https://gothru.co/file/L3VwbG9hZHMvZ290aHJ1X2FmaWxpYXRlX2ltYWdlXzE5ZWFjOWFjNGUucG5n) resolve with HTTP 200 and image headers.
      • /product/street-view-publishing: og:title, og:description, and og:image resolve with HTTP 200.
      • /download/gothru-photo-studio: og:title, og:description, and og:image resolve with HTTP 200.
      • Non-existent slug (/product/non-existent-sample-slug-qa-test-404): Returns clean 404 status.

issues.display_title: Issue #174: Fix Text Color Contrast in Pricing Modal Content
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by developer

screen-capture.31.webm

Description

Description

Text elements inside the pricing wizard modal (step counter "1/4", question title, option labels, and the "Back" button) are invisible due to matching font and background colors. Text is only readable when highlighted manually.

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Update CSS color rules so all text elements (heading, option lists, step indicator, and navigation buttons) are clearly visible against the white modal background.
  2. Ensure color contrast meets standard accessibility guidelines (WCAG).

QA Tester Summary — Issue #174: Fix Text Color Contrast in Pricing Modal Content

Status: Passed
Tested on: 2026-10-05
Suite: qa-testing/tests/e2e/pricing/issue_174_pricing_modal_contrast.spec.ts (Playwright · Chromium · Headed)
Env: Staging / Local Next.js Runtime (http://localhost:3000/pricing)
Account: Guest / Viewer (@viewer)

Executive Summary

Item Result
Feature Under Test Pricing Experience Wizard Modal Text Contrast & Accessibility
Root Cause Verified Modal text previously inherited text-white from parent dark section #222222, causing white-on-white invisible text against the modal background
Fix Implemented Added text-slate-900 wrapper on modal container and explicit dark contrast styling on headings, step counter (text-[#18A1F0]), options (text-slate-800), and Back button (text-black border-2 border-[#222222])
Test Coverage White Box (DOM styling & computed color verification), Gray Box (End-to-End multi-step wizard execution), Black Box (Negative reset & boundary option toggling)
Test Execution Status ✅ 1 Passed (0 Failed)
Final Verdict Passed · Fixed

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification (Developer Description Deep-Dive)

  • Problem Statement & Verification:
    • Previously, all text elements inside the pricing wizard modal (step indicator "1/4", question heading, options buttons, and "Back" button) were rendered with matching white text color over white container background (bg-white), rendering them invisible without manual highlight.
  • Code & Style Review:
    • src/components/pages/pricing/PricingExperience.tsx:
      • Modal container wrapper updated with text-slate-900 to establish proper base typography color.
      • Close button updated with text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700.
      • Step counter updated with text-[#18A1F0].
      • Question heading updated with text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900.
      • Options buttons styled with border-slate-200 text-slate-800 hover:border-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50 and selected state border-[#18A1F0] bg-sky-50 text-slate-900.
      • "Back" button styled with border-2 border-[#222222] bg-transparent text-black hover:bg-[#222222] hover:text-white.
      • Recommendation view updated with text-slate-900 and high-contrast summary text.

2. Test Scenario & Result

# Method Scenario Expected Actual Matrix Result
1 White Box modal_layout_contrast_check Modal opens and all typography elements (step counter, heading, options, buttons) render with high-contrast text against white background Computed text colors are dark (rgb(15, 23, 42) / #18A1F0) and clearly readable TP ✅ Pass
2 Gray Box wizard_step_flow_verification User completes 4-step questionnaire; Back button appears on step 2 with visible black text, option selections highlight in blue, recommendation renders with legible text Complete quiz flow completes with full visual clarity TP ✅ Pass
3 Black Box quiz_reset_and_modal_close User restarts questionnaire from recommendation screen and closes dialog via close button State resets to step 1 cleanly and modal dismisses without leftover overlay TP ✅ Pass

2. Inspect modal elements		 Modal opens with visible dark heading and blue step indicator Text is immediately legible ✅ Pass

2. Click Next
3. Inspect Back button on Step 2
4. Complete all steps		 Back button is visible with dark border and text; recommendation renders clearly All interactive elements visible and accessible ✅ Pass
TC-REG-03 Pricing / Recommendation Plan recommendation display & restart flow Quiz finished 1. Verify recommendation heading & price
2. Click "Start again"		 Matched plan details display in dark legible font; restart returns to Step 1 Smooth reset and clear contrast ✅ Pass

TC-STR-01 Modal / State Repeated Open, Complete, Reset, and Close Cycles Trigger 3 consecutive complete quiz cycles Modal opens, renders high-contrast text, resets, and closes cleanly without state corruption Stable execution without memory leaks or style regressions ✅ Pass

src/components/pages/pricing/PricingExperience.tsx Lines 339–448 Modal container and child elements updated with explicit Tailwind color utilities (text-slate-900, text-slate-800, text-black, text-[#18A1F0]), eliminating inherited white-on-white text bug.
